style: A premium logo mark for Zolva, a fintech app with automated trading agents, in the style of Aave's 3D brand icons: soft clay-like glossy 3D render, smooth rounded forms, soft diffused studio light from the top left, gentle lavender (#9896ff to #e5e5ff) as the main color with one small warm yellow (#ffc42c) accent and crisp white highlights. Simple, bold and readable even when shown very small, one clear idea, no clutter. Centered with generous empty space around it, isolated on a plain, perfectly flat pure white (#ffffff) background that touches every edge of the image. No words, no other letters, no numbers, no ground shadow, no border.

icons.z-ribbon-tile: Subject: an app icon tile, a rounded square in deep ink color #252228, holding one smooth glowing lavender ribbon that folds into a bold, clearly readable letter Z, its top-right end turning into a small yellow four-point spark.
icons.z-ribbon-mark: Subject: one thick smooth glowing lavender ribbon folded into a bold, clearly readable letter Z, floating on its own, its top-right end turning into a small yellow four-point spark. No tile behind it.
icons.watcher-tile: Subject: an app icon tile, a rounded square in deep ink color #252228, holding a glossy lavender sphere with a single round glowing pupil looking up and to the right, like a calm, friendly watcher keeping an eye on the market, with a tiny yellow glint in the eye.
icons.watcher-mark: Subject: a glossy lavender sphere with a single round glowing pupil looking up and to the right, like a calm, friendly watcher keeping an eye on the market, with a tiny yellow glint in the eye, floating on its own. No tile behind it.
icons.z-zigzag-tile: Subject: an app icon tile, a rounded square in deep ink color #252228, holding a thick glossy lavender line that zigzags like a rising price chart and forms a bold, clearly readable letter Z, ending at the top right in a small yellow star.
icons.z-zigzag-mark: Subject: a thick glossy lavender line that zigzags like a rising price chart and forms a bold, clearly readable letter Z, ending at the top right in a small yellow star, floating on its own. No tile behind it.

note: Logo concepts for the Zolva rebrand (2026-10-15). Approved by the user: 6 images, medium quality, about $0.28 total.
